t.why: With Liberia, Guinea and Ivory Coast it forms the Mano River Union.
t.rel: It went through the 'blood diamond' civil war of the 1990s. With Liberia, Guinea and Ivory Coast it forms the Mano River Union.
t.know: Its 'blood diamond' civil war made the world aware of conflict minerals.
t.etext: It sells minerals such as iron ore, diamonds, gold and rutile. Having been through civil war and Ebola, it is still poor.
